name: gate-label-vocabulary
title: One vocabulary for the refusal labels, and the producers typed against it
description: GATE_LABELS is the closed set a manifest prediction is validated against, and the places that produce labels share no type with it: a typo in a producer would only show up as a refusal class nobody can predict. Derive the union from one source, type the producers, and check the policy gate list against it
